paragraphs: Bali. Bali reports Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, etc. Rabbi Chiyya told Bali, “I shall explain Yochanan’s meaning,” Ta'anit 18, end of a. Bali from Avimi Niyotai in Rav’s name; in Avimi Senavata’s name; from Rav Yaakov, Shmuel’s daughter’s son, Berakhot 25b. Rashi, Ta'anit, chapter 2: a sage’s name.
